title: Keys, drags and inline edits → client · server · contract
lede: The inbox below is `apps/triage.bl`: every key, drag and double-click is declared by the view as data.
hints: Press `?` for the keys: `j`/`k` move, `x` marks fixed, `e` or ⏎ renames inline, `p` cycles the priority. The view declares them as `:keys {"j" [:sel 3] …}`; the page rebuilds its keymap from every view, so a key the view does not offer does nothing — and the Worker refuses an event the view did not offer.

**Drag a row onto another** to reorder: `:drag "3"` on a row, `:on-drop [:drop]` on the target. The reorder is the team's (`:move-report`), predicted in the browser so the row lands at once and glides into place, then confirmed by the server.
The selected row takes focus (`:focused`), so screen readers and Tab follow the keyboard selection.
